page_title: RAY 0-1 VAL | Rayo Vallecano v Valencia 19/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+9' Rayo Vallecano can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
90+8' Rayo Vallecano fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
90+5' Mouctar Diakhaby (Valencia) gets a yellow card.
90+3' A decent effort by Raul de Tomas (Rayo Vallecano) from a close-range free kick! His attempt flies narrowly over the crossbar.
90+2' A substitution has been made. Selim Amallah goes off and Gabriel Paulista (Valencia) comes on.
90+1' The ref signals that VAR has overturned that yellow card and upgraded it to a straight red for Thierry Correia (Valencia). He’s got to go!
90+1' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident from earlier. This could be a red card for Thierry Correia (Valencia)! Let's see what he decides.
90' We will have 7 min. of added time.
90' Raul de Tomas (Rayo Vallecano) will take a free kick. Is he going to strike the ball directly at the goal? Let's find out!
87' Bebe (Rayo Vallecano) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
82' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Hugo Gonzalez (Valencia) replaces Sergi Canos.
82' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Hugo Duro leaves the pitch and Roman Yaremchuk (Valencia) comes on.
81' Fran Perez (Valencia) has tested the patience of referee Javier Alberola Rojas and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
81' Here comes a substitution. Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) is given a rest as he is replaced by Alvaro Garcia.
80' Substitution. Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) leaves the pitch and is replaced by Radamel Falcao.
75' Selim Amallah (Valencia) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
75' Pepelu (Valencia) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
75' The ball is out of play and Valencia manage to earn a corner. Pepelu (Valencia) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
73' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Bebe (Rayo Vallecano) heads on.
71' The referee allows time for a substitution. Jesus Vazquez will be replaced by Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia).
71' Here comes a substitution. Fran Perez (Valencia) is brought on as a substitute for Diego Lopez.
70' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Kike Perez (Rayo Vallecano) was quite harsh and Javier Alberola Rojas didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
70' The corner is swung in but Rayo Vallecano can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
69' Francisco decides to make a substitution. Jorge de Frutos will be replaced by Bebe (Rayo Vallecano).
69' Substitution. Kike Perez (Rayo Vallecano) replaces Unai Lopez.
69' Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Giorgi Mamardashvili intercepts the ball. Rayo Vallecano get a corner.

69' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
68' Pepelu (Valencia) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by Stole Dimitrievski.
64' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
62' The substitution has been made. Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano) has replaced Sergio Camello.
61' 0 - 1 Goal! Diego Lopez plays a short, square pass into the path of Sergi Canos (Valencia), who bends a shot straight into the top left corner to make it 0:1. Fabulous goal!
61' The goalkeeper dives to deny Sergi Canos (Valencia), whose promising shot was aimed towards the left post.
60' 1:1 – this is the current number of shots on target.
58' The Rayo Vallecano players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
56' Giorgi Mamardashvili comes off his line to intercept the corner from Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano).

55' Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger. Rayo Vallecano earn a corner.
52' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) takes a mid-range free kick, but his miskick only goes into the stands. Poor shot!
50' Javier Alberola Rojas shows a yellow card to Jesus Vazquez (Valencia) for his blatant foul.
49' Hugo Duro (Valencia) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+1' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' Selim Amallah (Valencia) makes a good run with the ball, but his shot from the edge of the penalty area goes narrowly over the bar. Terrific solo effort, though.
44' It looks like Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) saw red with that tackle. Javier Alberola Rojas won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
41' Flag goes up against Hugo Duro (Valencia) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
40' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Thierry Correia (Valencia), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
37' Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) tries to find Isi Palazon, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valencia.
34' Hugo Guillamon (Valencia) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Javier Alberola Rojas had an easy-decision to make.
32' Selim Amallah (Valencia) wriggles into space and fires the ball from the edge of the area, but one of the defenders is there to block the effort.
32' Stole Dimitrievski pulls off a great save to deny Diego Lopez (Valencia) who, makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive towards the middle of the goal.
30' Rayo Vallecano hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
27' Hugo Duro (Valencia) is adjudged offside.
24' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) finds himself unmarked on the edge of the box, but he drags his shot just wide of the right post.
23' The corner from Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) is hurriedly cleared.

23' Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off. The linesman points to the corner flag, Rayo Vallecano are going to take it.
21' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
21' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
18' Hugo Duro almost found himself in a promising position after Pepelu (Valencia) tried to send a defence-splitting pass, but one of the defenders reacts well and makes a timely interception.
16' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
14' Hugo Duro (Valencia) is clearly in an offside position after the ball is played through to him and the linesman raises his flag.
13' The free kick is taken by Pepelu (Valencia), but ball is cleared.

13' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Javier Alberola Rojas with no other option than to blow for a foul. Free kick. Valencia will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
11' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) weaves through the defence and gets one-on-one with the keeper, but fails to score.
9' Rayo Vallecano have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
9' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. Rayo Vallecano have a corner.
8' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.

7' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. Rayo Vallecano force their opponents to concede a corner.
5' Pepelu (Valencia) bursts pass a defender and attempts to score from the edge of the area, but the shot goes high over the bar.
3' Raul de Tomas (Rayo Vallecano) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
1' The match has just started.
Rayo Vallecano will kick-off.
Javier Alberola Rojas got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
